🎓 How to Use the AI Impact Matrix Skill

Before you install, here's how to get the most out of this skill in Joule Work Desktop.

💬

Trigger Phrases

Say any of these to Joule:

  • "AI impact matrix"
  • "Which tasks should AI do?"
  • "AI transformation plan"
  • "What should stay human?"
  • "30-day AI pilot"
📝

Sample Prompt

Try this in Joule:

"Run the AI impact matrix on my PMM activities. I spend most of my time on competitive research, sales deck creation, and launch coordination. Help me identify what to automate first."
📊

What You'll Get

  • Classification — Each task sorted into AI Production, AI Augmented, or Human-Essential
  • Time Recovery — Hours/week you could save
  • Quick Wins — 3 things to automate this week
  • 30-Day Pilot — Detailed plan for your first AI workflow
💡

Pro Tips

  • Be specific — List actual activities, not categories
  • Include time estimates — "I spend 4 hours/week on X"
  • Mention pain points — "This is repetitive" or "This blocks other work"
  • Ask follow-ups — "Go deeper on competitive research automation"
